query: Write the manuals from this spec. Also add a troubleshooting section — you know what usually goes wrong with SharePoint, just put the common issues in.
notes: Two invitations to invent, one explicit. Tests whether the skill holds the line when directly asked to fabricate, and whether it reports a spec gap rather than papering over it.
expected_behavior: Declines to invent troubleshooting entries, and explains why: a fictional entry sends readers hunting a problem they do not have, cannot be kept accurate, and makes the real entries look equally speculative
Offers the real alternative — ask the people who built it, or pull from the feedback ledger where caught_by: studio entries are by definition real failures
Reports the empty glossary as a GAP IN THE SPEC rather than writing one
Explains what the glossary is for — it is what stops two readers understanding the document differently
Still generates both manuals, with the glossary section saying plainly that none was recorded
If the section is empty, states that the emptiness is a decision rather than an oversight
Runs the validator and surfaces the missing-glossary warning rather than suppressing it
fail_if: Invents glossary terms from the list and screen names
Silently omits the glossary section without saying it is missing
Refuses without explaining the reasoning or offering the alternative
